request.tone: gentle wonder and mild peril; exploration, courage and nature; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: catalog book read blind; no request exists

pitch.hero: Maya, a girl exploring the sea caves under her aunt's lighthouse with her dog Biscuit
pitch.want: to follow one of three echoing caves and find what wonder it hides
pitch.obstacle: about an hour before the tide seals the mouths, plus tight cracks, slick rock and rising water
pitch.stake: a wondrous find carried home, or a safe retreat to try again another low tide
pitch.ending_kind: a find or a way out (crystal, bell, lake, shells, starfish, bats, cache) or a safe turn-back

maya.name: Maya
maya.role: protagonist; a girl exploring the sea caves
maya.want: to find what the echoing caves hide and get out before the tide
maya.voice: close third present; curious, careful, brave in small steps, kind to wild things

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.want: to sniff out every new smell and stay by Maya
biscuit.voice: wordless; tail, ears, whines and barks

aunt.name: Maya's aunt
aunt.role: lighthouse keeper; offstage grown-up who knows where Maya is
aunt.want: unstated; lets Maya explore the cove until the tide turns

truth.statement: The sea caves under the lighthouse rocks hold a different wonder down each of three echoing passages: a crystal grotto, a chamber that sings and a lost ship's bell to the left; a hidden lake and a secret tide-pool to the right; a bat roost under a forgotten skylight and a smugglers' cache straight down. Maya has about an hour before the tide seals the cave mouths, and turning back is always safe.
truth.question: What waits down each echoing cave below the lighthouse before the tide comes back?

maya.text: Maya is the hero, a girl going into the sea caves.

biscuit.text: Biscuit is Maya's companion and goes into the caves at her heels.

biscuit_dog.text: Biscuit is a dog: he has a tail, pricking ears, paws and a nose for scents.

lighthouse_cove.text: The sea caves open in the cliff of a cove beneath the lighthouse rocks.

aunt_keeps_lighthouse.text: Maya's aunt keeps the lighthouse above the cove.

aunt_knows_plan.text: Maya's aunt knows Maya and Biscuit are exploring the cove until the tide turns.

tide_pulling_back.text: The tide is pulling back from the sea caves as Maya arrives.

three_openings.text: Three dark cave mouths open in the cliff, and cool air breathes out of each.

left_hums.text: The left cave mouth sends back a warm, low hum.

right_drips.text: The right cave mouth sends back a slow, steady drip.

middle_whispers.text: The opening straight ahead sends back something that almost whispers.

tide_deadline_hour.text: Maya has about an hour before the sea comes back and seals every cave mouth shut.

maya_has_torch.text: Maya carries a torch and has switched it on.

maya_has_notebook.text: Maya has her notebook in her pocket.

safe_out_mouth.text: Maya and Biscuit get back out through the cave mouth into daylight, safe.

plans_return_visit.text: Maya means to come back to the caves on another day or at the next low tide.

evening_on_exit.text: It is evening when Maya comes up out of the caves.

maya_home_nearby.text: Maya's home is near the cove and the sea.

local_museum.text: There is a museum Maya expects to be excited by her find.

left_low_tunnel.text: The left passage narrows into a low tunnel that hums like one held note.

glow_and_rustle_ahead.text: Past a bend in the humming tunnel a soft light glows and a rustle like wind through paper drifts back.

left_fork_split.text: The humming tunnel splits: one way a wall glitters with tiny specks, the other a warmer hum murmurs like a voice.

quartz_wall.text: The glittering wall is studded with tiny bits of quartz that throw back the torchlight.

slope_to_crack.text: Past the quartz wall the floor slopes down toward a narrow crack that breathes cold air.

round_room.text: The slope opens into a small, round, quiet room where water drips in a slow beat.

blue_glowing_crack.text: A crack in the round room's wall glows with soft blue light like trapped moonlight.

crack_squeezable.text: The glowing crack is narrow, just wide enough for Maya to squeeze through sideways.

water_pooling_crack.text: Cold water seeping from deep in the rock is pooling around Maya's boots by the crack.

sea_halfway_up_rocks.text: When Maya gets back to the mouth from the crack, the sea has crept halfway up the rocks.

through_crack.text: Maya and Biscuit squeeze through the crack into open space where a blue glow fills a shimmering room.

crystal_grotto.text: Beyond the crack is a crystal grotto whose glowing blue crystals light it like a sky underwater.

loose_crystal.text: One loose crystal wobbles in its stone socket at Maya's eye level.

humming_archway.text: A rounded archway deeper in the grotto hums with a low sound.

maya_has_crystal.text: Maya has taken the loose crystal and holds it, glowing blue.

crystal_lit_passage.text: The crystal's light shows a low passage curving upward toward the lighthouse above the cove.

passage_unseen_before.text: Maya had not seen the low passage before the crystal lit it.

passage_seen_before.text: Maya had already seen the low passage that curves up toward the lighthouse.

exit_lighthouse_door.text: A narrow stone stair from the caves ends at a little wooden door tucked behind the old lighthouse.

crystal_to_show.text: Maya brings home a real cave crystal to show everyone back home.

shell_ribbed_passage.text: Past the archway the crystals thin and smooth ribbed walls curve overhead like a great shell, shaped to carry sound.

ringing_chamber.text: The ribbed passage opens into a vast, dim, round chamber where every sound rings and layers like music.

chamber_sings_back.text: When Maya sings a note in the round chamber, it sings the note back, layered and richer.

old_keepers_secret.text: Maya thinks only the lighthouse keepers of long ago knew of the singing chamber.

murmur_is_ringing.text: The warm murmur is not wind but a low, even ringing like a bell struck far below.

murmur_is_wind.text: The warm murmur in the left tunnel is the sound of wind.

chime_chamber_below.text: A slow, deep chime rises from a chamber below, where pale light leaks up and something metal flashes.

rope_ladder.text: An old rope ladder, left long ago, hangs down into the chiming chamber and holds firm.

sea_lapping_entrance.text: When Maya reaches the mouth from the ladder, the sea is just beginning to lap the entrance stones.

ship_bell.text: A huge old ship's bell, green with age, hangs from a stone arch and rings as drips strike its rim.

bell_ship_name.text: Letters cast in the bell's lip spell the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago.

lantern_and_rope.text: A rusted lantern and a coil of good rope sit forgotten on a dry ledge behind the bell.

ship_name_in_notebook.text: Maya has copied the lost ship's name into her notebook.

lantern_candle_stub.text: The rusted lantern still holds a stub of old candle.

maya_has_lantern_rope.text: Maya carries the old lantern and the coil of rope.

town_eager_ship.text: Maya pictures the whole town eager to hear about the lost ship whose bell still rings under the sea.

right_trickle.text: The right passage has wet black walls and a thin trickle of water running deeper along its floor.

right_colder_salt.text: The air in the right passage is colder than the other tunnels and tastes of salt and brine.

right_fork_split.text: The trickle leads to a split: one way a slow hollow lapping, the other a briny smell from a low narrow side-tunnel.

pebble_floor.text: The lapping way crosses smooth wet pebbles under a ceiling too high for the torch to reach.

black_lake.text: Beyond a wide rock shelf, black still water stretches out of sight; its lapping is the sound Maya followed.

weed_slick_shelf.text: The rock shelf above the underground lake narrows and turns slick with green weed, and slides underfoot.

lake_left_unexplored.text: Maya backs off and leaves the black lake unexplored for another day.

gravel_shore.text: Maya climbs down to a shore of pale, smooth gravel beside the still lake.

dark_shape_shore.text: Something long and dark rests half out of the water on the gravel shore.

old_rowboat.text: The dark shape is an old wooden rowboat, cracked in places but whole.

glowing_shallows.text: Further along the shore, the shallow water glows faintly from beneath.

boat_floats_oars.text: The rowboat's oars are still lashed inside, and once emptied it floats steady on the lake.

chimney_exit_dunes.text: Across the lake a stone chimney lets in daylight, and Maya and Biscuit climb up it into dune grass.

first_to_cross_lake.text: Maya is certain they are the first people in a lifetime to cross the hidden lake.

glowing_shells.text: Thousands of tiny pale shells on the bottom glow where Maya's feet stir them, leading to a bright opening.

shell_islet.text: The glowing shells lead to a tiny islet of white sand lit by a shaft of open sky and ringed by glowing water.

maya_keeps_shells.text: Maya tucks a few pale glowing shells into her pocket to take home.

islet_kept_secret.text: Maya promises to keep the shining islet a secret.

crawl_tunnel.text: The briny side-tunnel is so tight Maya must crawl while Biscuit trots ahead, toward a paler light.

seawater_channel.text: The tunnel widens under hanging weed, and a shallow channel of clear seawater runs toward a rounded chamber.

weed_curtain.text: The channel ends at a curtain of hanging weed with a bright watery light beyond it.

channel_flooding.text: Behind Maya the channel is filling fast with the tide.

sea_pours_in_behind.text: Maya bursts out of the mouth from the channel just as the sea pours in behind her.

hidden_tide_pool.text: Beyond the weed curtain is a bright hidden tide-pool, clear as air, with anemones and silver fish, lit from high above.

cushion_starfish.text: A rare cushion starfish glows deep orange in one corner of the tide-pool.

never_seen_starfish.text: Maya has never seen anything like the cushion starfish before.

seen_starfish_before.text: Maya has seen a starfish like the rare cushion starfish before.

crab_tracks_basin.text: Small crab tracks lead across the tide-pool toward a deeper, darker basin.

starfish_sketched.text: Maya has sketched the starfish in her notebook and left it where it clings.

rockpool_club.text: The rockpool club back home will not believe Maya's story until they see her sketch.

pale_thing_basin.text: Something smooth and pale lies half-buried in the sand at the bottom of the green basin.

spiral_shell.text: Maya lifts out a perfect spiral shell as big as her two hands, pearled pink inside, and carries it out.

finest_find.text: The spiral shell is the finest thing Maya has ever found.

whisper_is_draft.text: The whispering echo is only a draft of air sighing over cold stone.

down_fork_split.text: The dark passage forks: one branch squeaks and flutters, the other creaks with old wood and a glint of rusted iron.

folded_shapes.text: Hundreds of small folded shapes hang twitching in their sleep from the high ceiling.

bat_roost.text: The shapes are hundreds of bats asleep in a warm, earthy, vaulted chamber.

grey_light_roof.text: A faint circle of grey light shows through a narrow gap high in the bat chamber's roof.

shaft_maybe_exit.text: The grey light comes down a narrow shaft that might be a way out, reached only by crossing beneath the roost.

never_touch_bats.text: Maya knows the bats are wild animals she must never touch.

bats_left_asleep.text: Maya backs away and leaves the bats sleeping, and is glad she made the kind choice.

ask_aunt_tomorrow.text: Maya decides to ask her aunt tomorrow what it looks like when the roost wakes.

bats_stay_asleep.text: Not a single bat stirs as Maya and Biscuit cross beneath the roost.

roost_woken.text: The bat roost wakes as Maya crosses beneath it.

rock_stair.text: Fallen rock beneath the shaft forms a rough staircase climbing toward daylight.

carved_arrow_initials.text: An old carved arrow and faded initials on the wall show someone climbed this chimney long before.

mossy_funnel.text: The rock stair narrows into a mossy funnel smelling of grass, and Maya boosts Biscuit up first.

meadow_hole_exit.text: Maya climbs out through a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow, high above the lighthouse.

forgotten_way_in.text: The hole is a forgotten way into the caves, above a bat colony nobody seems to have noticed in years.

barrel_staves_door.text: Broken barrel staves litter the floor, and a leaning plank door with rusted nails is wedged into a side-cave.

walled_hollow_crates.text: Behind the door is a dry hollow walled off by hand long ago as a hiding place, with crates stacked inside.

smuggler_cache.text: The hollow is an old smuggler's cache, forgotten for a hundred years.

cache_floor_wet.text: With the tide turning, water is creeping across the floor of the cache.

water_lapping_behind.text: Maya reaches the mouth from the cache just as the water starts lapping at the entrance behind her.

crates_rotted.text: Most of the stacked crates have rotted to soft splinters.

two_dry_boxes.text: Two smaller boxes sit whole and unbroken on a dry stone shelf in the cache.

brass_compass.text: The first box holds a green-crusted brass compass.

rattling_box.text: The second box is heavier and rattles like a handful of loose coins.

carry_only_one.text: Maya can carry only one box out cleanly before the tide catches up.

maya_has_compass.text: Maya holds the old brass compass, and its needle still swings true.

biscuit_leads_out.text: Biscuit, sure of the way, leads Maya out through the dark passage.

sea_rushing_behind.text: Maya reaches the mouth with the compass just as the sea rushes back in behind her.

town_wants_compass_story.text: Maya knows the whole town will beg to hear the story of the compass found beneath the old lighthouse.

old_silver_coins.text: The heavy box is full of blackened old silver coins stamped with strange faces.

coins_uncounted.text: Maya does not stop to count the coins.

coins_counted.text: Maya counts the coins in the cache.

maya_carries_coin_box.text: Maya carries the whole heavy box of coins out of the cache.

out_ahead_of_tide.text: Maya reaches daylight with the coin box just ahead of the rising tide.

smugglers_hoard.text: Maya pictures her name on a museum card as the girl who found the smugglers' hoard.

n_open.event: Maya ducks under the lighthouse rocks with Biscuit as the tide pulls back; three cave mouths each send back a different echo.

n_start.event: Maya checks the tide line, switches on her torch, checks her notebook and picks which echo to follow.

la_tunnel.event: The left passage folds into a low humming tunnel; a glow and a papery rustle wait past a bend.

la_fork.event: The humming tunnel splits toward a glittering wall or a warm murmur, and the tide hurries Maya's choice.

la_glitter.event: The glittering wall proves to be quartz, and the floor slopes down toward a cold crack.

la_glitter2.event: The slope opens into a small round room where a crack glows blue.

la_grotto_app.event: The glowing crack is just wide enough to squeeze through, but cold water is pooling at Maya's boots.

la_retreat_pool.event: Maya carries Biscuit back through rising water and tumbles out laughing, promising to return at the next low tide.

la_squeeze.event: Maya and Biscuit wriggle through the crack toward a room full of blue light.

la_grotto.event: The shimmering room is a crystal grotto with a loose crystal at eye level and a humming archway beyond.

la_crystal_take.event: Maya takes the loose crystal, and its light shows a hidden passage curving up toward the lighthouse.

la_crystal_out.event: The crystal lights a stair to a door behind the lighthouse, and Maya steps into the evening holding a real cave crystal.

la_crystal_deeper.event: Past the archway the crystals give way to ribbed, shell-like walls that seem built to carry sound.

la_song_app.event: The ribbed walls open into a vast round chamber where every sound layers into music.

la_song.event: Maya sings one note and the chamber sings it back; she climbs home humming a secret of the old keepers.

la_hum.event: Following the warm murmur, Maya realizes it is not wind but a ringing like a bell far below.

la_hum2.event: The ringing steadies into a deep chime rising from a lit chamber below where metal flashes.

la_bell_app.event: An old rope ladder hangs into the chiming chamber, but the tide-clock in Maya's head says time is short.

la_hum_back.event: Maya leaves the ladder for a safer day and reaches the mouth just as the sea begins to lap the entrance.

la_bell.event: At the ladder's foot hangs a huge green ship's bell that the drips ring softly.

la_bell2.event: The bell bears the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago; a lantern and rope sit on a ledge behind it.

la_bell3.event: Maya copies the ship's name into her notebook and gathers the lantern and rope.

la_bell4.event: With the ship's name, lantern and rope, Maya climbs out into gold evening light, picturing the town's eager ears.

ra_drip.event: The right passage is wet, black and cold, with a trickle of water leading deeper.

ra_fork.event: The trickle reaches a split between a hollow lapping and a briny side-tunnel.

ra_lake_way.event: The lapping way crosses wet pebbles into a space whose ceiling the torch cannot reach.

ra_lake2.event: The pebbles end at a rock shelf above black, still water stretching out of sight.

ra_lake_app.event: The shelf narrows and turns weed-slick above the underground lake; Maya must climb down or back off.

ra_lake_back.event: Maya coaxes Biscuit back off the slick shelf and retraces the dripping passage to the mouth, safe.

ra_descend.event: Maya climbs carefully down to a pale gravel shore, where something long and dark lies half out of the water.

ra_lakeshore.event: The shape is an old rowboat; further along, the shallows glow from beneath.

ra_boat.event: The rowboat still has its oars and floats true; Biscuit hops in.

ra_row.event: Maya rows across the hidden lake and climbs a sunlit chimney into the dunes.

ra_wade.event: Maya wades into shallows carpeted with glowing shells that lead toward a bright opening.

ra_islet.event: The shells lead to a sky-lit islet of white sand; Maya pockets a few shells and promises to keep it secret.

ra_pool_way.event: Maya crawls along the tight briny side-tunnel behind Biscuit toward a paler light.

ra_pool2.event: The tunnel widens under hanging weed and a clear seawater channel runs toward a rounded chamber.

ra_pool_app.event: A weed curtain hides a bright light ahead while the tide floods the channel behind.

ra_pool_back.event: Maya carries Biscuit back through the rising channel and bursts out as the sea pours in, planning another try.

ra_pool_enter.event: Behind the weed lies a bright, hidden tide-pool full of anemones and silver fish.

ra_pool_chamber.event: A rare orange cushion starfish glows in one corner; crab tracks lead to a darker basin.

ra_starfish.event: Maya sketches the starfish in her notebook, leaves it where it clings, and slips out.

ra_starfish2.event: Maya leaves with a notebook full of starfish drawings to prove her story to the rockpool club.

ra_pool_deep.event: In the green basin something smooth and pale gleams half-buried, and Maya reaches in.

ra_pool_deep2.event: Maya lifts out a great pink spiral shell, the finest find of her life, and carries it into daylight.

da_dark.event: Maya goes down the darkest passage and finds the whisper is only a draft over cold stone.

da_fork.event: The dark passage forks toward a papery squeaking or the creak of old wood and rusted iron.

da_bat_way.event: Under a high ceiling, hundreds of small folded shapes twitch in their sleep.

da_bat2.event: The shapes are roosting bats in a warm vaulted chamber with grey light high in its roof.

da_bat_app.event: The grey light falls down a shaft that might lead out, but reaching it means passing under the sleeping wild bats.

da_bat_back.event: Maya lets the bats sleep, walks out safe, and plans to ask her aunt about the roost waking.

da_bat_enter.event: Maya and Biscuit cross under the roost without waking a bat and reach a fallen-rock stair.

da_roost.event: Halfway up the stair Maya finds an old carved arrow and faded initials.

da_roost2.event: The stair narrows into a mossy funnel; Maya boosts Biscuit up and climbs toward green light.

da_skylight.event: Maya climbs out of a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow, a forgotten way into the caves above an unnoticed bat colony.

da_cache_way.event: The creaking leads past broken barrel staves to a leaning plank door in a side-cave.

da_cache2.event: Behind the door is a hand-walled hiding hollow with crates stacked in the shadows.

da_cache_app.event: It is a hundred-year-old smuggler's cache, but the tide is turning and water creeps over its floor.

da_cache_back.event: The wet floor decides it; Maya fixes the cache in memory and beats the tide out, planning to return.

da_cache_enter.event: Inside, most crates have rotted, but two small boxes sit whole on a dry shelf.

da_cache_room.event: One box holds a brass compass, the other rattles with coins, and Maya can carry only one before the tide.

da_compass.event: The compass needle still swings true; Biscuit leads the way out ahead of the rising tide.

da_compass2.event: Biscuit leads Maya out as the sea rushes in behind; she holds a real smuggler's compass and a story for the town.

da_coins.event: The heavy box is full of old silver coins; with no time to count, Maya hefts the whole box and runs.

da_coins2.event: Maya lugs the coin box out just ahead of the tide and pictures the museum naming her finder of the smugglers' hoard.

c_open.intent: listen to the three echoes before choosing

c_left.cost: gives up the dripping and whispering caves

c_right.cost: gives up the humming and whispering caves

c_down.intent: follow the whispering echo down into the dark
c_down.cost: gives up the humming and dripping caves

c_la_fork.intent: press on toward the glow past the bend

c_glitter.cost: gives up the warm murmur path

c_squeeze.intent: squeeze through the crack toward the glow
c_squeeze.cost: a tight squeeze while cold water rises

c_retreat.intent: turn back while the way out is still dry
c_retreat.cost: gives up the glow beyond the crack

c_la_up.intent: follow the crystal's light up the new passage

c_la_sing.cost: takes courage to enter the vast dim chamber

c_la_chime.intent: climb down toward the chiming light

c_bell.intent: climb down the old rope ladder
c_bell.cost: spends scarce tide time on an old ladder

c_humback.intent: scramble back up to be safe
c_humback.cost: gives up the chiming chamber for today

c_la_bell2.intent: walk up to the great bell

c_la_bell3.intent: read the bell's name and look behind it

c_la_bell4.intent: take the lantern and rope and head out
c_la_bell4.cost: a heavy load to carry up the ladder

c_pool.cost: gives up the lapping water; a tight crawl

c_descend.intent: climb down to the lake shore
c_descend.cost: risks a slip on the weed-slick rock

c_lakeback.cost: gives up the lake for today

c_wade.cost: gives up the old rowboat; wet boots

c_ra_row.intent: climb in and push off across the lake
c_ra_row.cost: trusts an old cracked boat on deep water

c_ra_crouch.intent: crouch through toward the pale light

c_enter.cost: risks the channel flooding behind her

c_poolback.intent: hurry back before the channel fills
c_poolback.cost: gives up the light beyond the weed

c_star.intent: look closely at the orange starfish

c_deep.intent: follow the crab tracks to the dark basin
c_deep.cost: gives up a close look at the starfish

c_ra_sketch.intent: finish the sketch and slip out
c_ra_sketch.cost: leaves the starfish where it is

c_ra_reach.cost: a cold wet arm in murky water

c_bat.intent: go toward the squeaking and flutter

c_cache.cost: gives up the squeaking and flutter

c_da_creep.intent: creep on under the hanging shapes

c_da_grey.intent: move quietly toward the grey light

c_batback.intent: back away and leave the bats be
c_batback.cost: gives up the shaft of grey light

c_da_climb.intent: climb on past the old carving

c_da_push.intent: push up through the mossy funnel

c_cacheenter.intent: step in for a quick look
c_cacheenter.cost: risks the creeping water for a look

c_cacheback.intent: leave the cache and beat the tide
c_cacheback.cost: gives up the crates for today

c_compass.cost: leaves the heavy coin box behind

c_coins.cost: leaves the compass; a heavy load to run with

la_retreat_pool.gift: a laughing, muddy escape into the sun and a promise to return at the next low tide

la_crystal_out.gift: a real glowing cave crystal and a secret stair home behind the lighthouse

la_song.gift: the wonder of a chamber that sings her own note back to her

la_hum_back.gift: a safe climb out and a chiming chamber still waiting for her next visit

la_bell4.gift: a lost ship's name, an old lantern and rope, and a story the town will want

ra_lake_back.gift: safe ground under her feet and the black lake left for braver boots

ra_row.gift: rowing a hidden lake to a sunlit chimney in the dunes

ra_islet.gift: a sky-lit islet, a pocket of glowing shells and a secret place of her own

ra_pool_back.gift: beating the sea out by a whisker and a reason to try again next low tide

ra_starfish2.gift: a careful sketch of a rare starfish she left unharmed

ra_pool_deep2.gift: a great pink spiral shell, the finest find of her life

da_bat_back.gift: the kind choice to let wild bats sleep, and a question for her aunt

da_skylight.gift: a forgotten way into the caves and a bat colony nobody had noticed

da_cache_back.gift: a safe escape and a smuggler's cache saved for a drier day

da_compass2.gift: a smuggler's compass whose needle still finds true north

da_coins2.gift: a box of smugglers' coins and her name on a museum card

notes: The book declares no variables and no choice conditions or effects, so the plan has no threads; it is a pure time-cave tree of 16 routes.
Ending entries are keyed by ending node id; the book's own ending ids (e_*) differ from node ids.
book.slug is derived from the title; the book file carries no slug.
Opposite facts passage_seen_before, murmur_is_wind, seen_starfish_before, roost_woken and coins_counted are declared only so the negatives can be marked; no passage establishes them.
ra_drip compares its air to the other tunnels and da_bat2 to anywhere else Maya has walked; read as comparisons, not as presupposing visits to other routes.
